hook.name: Flash
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the FLASH protocol implementing WETH-rooted token pools with a static 0.6% LP fee, sell taxes distributed to stakers, pool creators, and protocol, OTC buy-side fills from an on-chain inventory deck, and multi-venue buy aggregation. Swaps require a governance-activated directional protocol fee to be set before executing.
